source.author: verg
source.text: Talibus attonitus visis et voce deorum nec sopor illud erat, sed coram aggnoscere voltus velatasque comas praesentiaque ora videbar; tum gelidus toto manabat corpore sudor corripio e stratis corpus, tendoque supinas ad caelum cum voce manus, et munera libo intemerata focis.
source.text_original: Talibus attonitus visis et voce deorum — / nec sopor illud erat, sed coram aggnoscere voltus / velatasque comas praesentiaque ora videbar; / tum gelidus toto manabat corpore sudor / corripio e stratis corpus, tendoque supinas / ad caelum cum voce manus, et munera libo / intemerata focis.
source.text_english: Astonished by such sights and by the voice of the gods, and it was not sleep, but I seemed to recognize before me their faces, their veiled hair, and their present countenances; then cold sweat flowed over my whole body. I snatched my body from the bed, and with a cry I stretched my hands upward to the sky, and I poured untouched offerings on the hearths.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: nec uero sopor ille fuerat aut uana somnia, quibus saepe deludimur.
reuse.text_original: nec uero sopor ille fuerat aut uana somnia, quibus saepe deludimur.
reuse.text_english: Nor was that a mere sleep, or empty dreams, by which we are often deceived.
